reviews.title: Perfect case for budget build
reviews.comment: The case looks amazing and the Rgb modes are very nice, would buy again for another build compatibility with matx/micro/atx builds is good, the build is Good for a budget case. Love the small screen that displays the GPU temps and CPU temps and functions as expected after software download. The airflow is good as far as I know cpu temps are on point. Instructions are abit off but not hatd if u know what ur doing.

reviews.author: ShoeBox

reviews.title: Great case, good price point, decent build quality and top notch styling.
reviews.comment: I honestly love the look and feel of this case, the glass looks amazing and the build feels strong enough to keep up with moving this around if you ever have to. it's very easy to do cable management with lots of grooves and areas for you to tie cables too. There are 2 slots for 2.5 ssd's and one for a full-size hard drive that a little harder to locate unless you download the manual off their website. The motherboard standoffs are a little annoying to remove but other than that everything seemed ready to go out the box. Air flow is great, temps are great but there are only filters at the top and bottom not the side or rear so if you set those to intake it will be sucking in dust. Overall extremely functional just be aware the front temp screen will require a motherboard USB connection to run. My main gripe is the rear GPU slots that are usually removable are snap off style and one remove can not be reinstalled.
reviews.author: sebastian mora
